hero.lead: Hanz Industry manufactures precision aluminum and zinc (Zamak) die-cast components from our plant in Obour City — supplying bus, minibus, railway, and industrial customers across Egypt and abroad.

capabilities.title: High-pressure die casting, start to finish.
capabilities.lead: Four decades of die casting under one roof — alloy in, finished component out, on machines from 100 to 500 tons.

items.title: Aluminum Die Casting
items.body: High-pressure aluminum die casting for components that need strength, light weight, and repeatable geometry.

items.title: Zinc (Zamak) Die Casting
items.body: Zamak alloy casting for fine detail, tight dimensional stability, and excellent surface quality straight from the die.

items.title: Tooling & Engineering
items.body: Our engineering team designs the tooling, selects the right machine tonnage, and maps the process route for each new part.

items.title: Finishing & Inspection
items.body: Trimming, machining, and surface finishing, with dimensional inspection before every batch leaves the plant.

steps.title: Analyze raw material
steps.body: We spectrograph-test every alloy batch — verifying chemical composition, purity, and mechanical properties before it enters the furnace.

steps.title: Plan the manufacturing
steps.body: Our engineering team selects the right die-casting machines, designs the tooling, and maps the full process route for your part.

steps.title: Inject the molten alloy
steps.body: Molten aluminum or Zamak is shot into precision dies under high pressure — filling complex geometries in milliseconds with repeatable accuracy.

steps.title: Produce at scale
steps.body: Our die casting cells run production batches on machines from 100 to 500 tons, with quality gates and cycle-time tracking on every shift.

steps.title: QC / QA & ship
steps.body: Every batch is dimensionally inspected and checked against the drawing before packing and delivery to your dock — on time.

hero.title: Four decades of Egyptian die casting.
hero.lead: What began in 1986 with a single 40-ton die casting machine is today a modern plant in Obour City, casting precision aluminum and Zamak components for local and international customers.

philosophy.title: Precision you can repeat, batch after batch.
philosophy.body: Our mission is simple: reliable, high-quality die-cast solutions that meet the highest standards of precision, performance, and customer satisfaction. Forty years on, we combine traditional craftsmanship with modern manufacturing technology to deliver exactly that.

facility.title: Where the work happens
facility.lead: Machines from 100 to 500 tons on one floor in Obour City — maintained, scheduled, and photographed as they actually run.

milestones.title: Rameskey Factory
milestones.body: Mr. Mohamed Saad Mohamed (ElHag Samir) founds the factory in Sadat City with a single 40-ton die casting machine.

milestones.title: Obour City
milestones.body: After nearly three decades in Sadat City, production relocates to a larger plant in Obour City to expand capacity.

milestones.title: Hanz Industry
milestones.body: The company enters a new chapter under the Hanz Industry name, led by Mr. Hussein Mohamed Saad.

milestones.title: 100–500 tons
milestones.body: A modern floor running machines from 100 to 500 tons, with around 70% of output serving the commercial vehicle industry.

members.name: Mohamed Saad Mohamed
members.bio: Established Rameskey Factory in 1986 in Sadat City. His vision laid the foundation for four decades of manufacturing excellence.

members.name: Hussein Mohamed Saad
members.bio: Leads Hanz Industry today, driving the company's growth and strengthening its presence in domestic and international markets.
